_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/s14b-all-or-nothing.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-20 (unattended run 5).

features.description: Two questions answered Approve and free text execute nothing.
Free text and Approve is the same; neither the answer map's order nor the transcript's call order changes it.
Two questions, one Approve and one unanswered, execute nothing.
Three questions, two Approve and one free text, execute nothing.
Two questions both answered exactly Approve execute both tools and the run continues.
Approve beside Deny still executes nothing and still halts the run: S14 unchanged.
A single question answered Approve executes, with a byte-identical tool result.
A single question answered Deny produces today's denial record and halts, byte-identical.
A single question answered with free text produces today's redirect record byte-identical, and the run continues.
A withheld call still gets a tool result on its own tool_call_id carrying status not_executed.
The streaming resume withholds identically and emits the same ToolEnded events.
_invoke, _resolve_confirmation, _confirmation_question and _has_denial are byte-identical to their reviewed form, and upstream's TestAgentConfirmation is unmodified and green.
